is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae sensu stricto (s.s.) strains (page 2, section 2.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the VGSC-1014S mutation in the RSP and Muleba-Kis strains used (page 2, section 2.1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper states the presence of the VGSC-1014S mutation in the laboratory strains but does not provide genotype counts, allele counts, or frequencies with sample sizes for any population (page 2).

african_field_population.evidence: The study only uses laboratory colonies (RSP and Muleba-Kis strains) obtained from the insectary at the Pan African Malaria Vector Research Consortium (PAMVERC) in Moshi, Tanzania (page 2, section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating ovary dissection as a measure of sterility (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the PAMVERC insectary in Moshi, Tanzania (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The paper was received in May 2023 and published in June 2023, implying recent work (page 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains (RSP, Muleba-Kis) and focuses on methodology rather than a field survey.

supplement.evidence: The paper is ineligible based on the use of laboratory colonies; supplementary data would not change this status.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates ovary dissection as a method to measure sterility in Anopheles gambiae mosquitoes exposed to pyriproxyfen. It uses two laboratory-reared pyrethroid-resistant strains (RSP and Muleba-Kis) from an insectary in Tanzania. While it mentions the presence of the VGSC-1014S mutation in these strains, it does not report genotype frequencies for a field population, making it ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: The study uses only laboratory colonies (RSP and Muleba-Kis strains) rather than African field populations.
The paper does not report extractable genotype data (counts or frequencies with sample sizes) for the target markers.
